=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:262-295 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a re-plan, the cap split in `collect_paths` (`plan_limit = MAX_PATHS // 2 if text else MAX_PATHS`) does not reserve slots for current-issue paths. Previous-plan paths can still fill the ten-path cap and push out the tracked paths named in the current issue or user answers.
  WHY: All four reviewers rated this MAJOR. Three of them (sonnet, luna, glm) trace the cause to the same chain: `.github/workflows/plan.yml:1658-1659` appends all comments, so `_likely_section(text)` returns the previous plan's last "Files likely to change" section, and the deferred plan paths re-enter `ordered` because they are not in `seen`. Gemini instead blames the deferred paths being added back at lines 292-293 without respecting the total `MAX_PATHS`. Sonnet and glm add that the new test `test_replan_keeps_slots_for_issue_paths_when_previous_plan_is_long` does not cover this case.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:395-412 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `Builder.history`, the `_git(root, fetch)` result is not checked for `proc` being None (an OSError or SubprocessError in the wrapper) before `HISTORY_REF` is used.
  WHY: If `_git` returns None, the code goes on to run `git log` on `HISTORY_REF`, which may error or give unexpected output instead of cleanly reporting "history unavailable". The source rated this NIT.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:407 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The finally block in `Builder.history` calls `_git(root, ["update-ref", "-d", HISTORY_REF])` without capturing or handling the result.
  WHY: If the ref delete fails (for example because of a leftover lock), the failure is not recorded and the PERSIST line still reports "ok" or "partial". The source rated this NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion, not as a finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:collect_paths() | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In the text branch, `raw_candidates = list(_tfc.extract_paths_from_plan(_likely_section(text)))` runs before the PATH_IN_BACKTICKS_RE and _BARE_PATH_RE candidates are added. The loop skips only paths already in `seen`, not paths already in `deferred`. On a re-plan, `_likely_section(text)` starts at the previous plan's "Files likely to change" heading (.github/workflows/plan.yml (lines 1658-1659) writes every issue comment into PLANNING_CONTEXT_FILE), so paths 6..N of the previous plan go into `ordered` ahead of the issue and user-answer paths.
  WHY: When the previous plan lists 10 or more existing tracked files, `collect_paths` returns 10 previous-plan paths and drops the current-issue paths, so the pack has no open-PR overlap and no history for them. test_replan_keeps_slots_for_issue_paths_when_previous_plan_is_long misses this because its `new/p*.py` paths fail `safe_rel_path` and `_tracked`. Suggested fix: build `deferred_set = set(deferred)` and skip `path in deferred_set` when building `ordered`.
- HARDENING: scripts/evidence_pack.py, Builder.history, the `finally: _git(root, ["update-ref", "-d", HISTORY_REF])` call
  PROBLEM: The result of the ref delete is ignored. A SIGTERM during `git fetch` can leave a `refs/persist/history.lock` behind, so the delete fails silently, PERSIST still reports `ok` or `partial`, and the private ref survives into later steps of the job.
  WHY: Suggested fix: when the result is None or its returncode is non-zero, set `self.partial = True` and `self.reason = self.reason or "history_ref_cleanup_failed"`, and add that token to the agents fragment. About 4 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:277-293 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On re-plan, previous-plan paths can take all `MAX_PATHS` slots, because `plan_limit` (lines 278-283) applies only to paths from the previous plan text, and `deferred` paths are added back to `found` (lines 292-293) without respecting the total `MAX_PATHS` limit together with the issue-text paths.
  WHY: The evidence pack may contain previous-plan paths while leaving out relevant tracked paths that the current issue text explicitly asks for.
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:395-412 (within `Builder.history`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `_git(root, fetch)` result is not explicitly checked for `proc` being None before `HISTORY_REF` is used.
  WHY: If `_git` returns None, `git log` runs on `HISTORY_REF` and may error instead of cleanly reporting "history unavailable".
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:407 (within `Builder.history` finally block) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The finally block calls `_git(root, ["update-ref", "-d", HISTORY_REF])` without capturing or handling the result.
  WHY: If the ref delete fails (for example because of a leftover lock), the failure is not recorded and PERSIST still reports "ok" or "partial", which hides a cleanup problem.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:lines 267-293, especially 277 and 291-293 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The re-plan path cap can still fill with previous-plan paths. `_likely_section(text)` takes the last "Files likely to change" section from the planning context, and that context includes all issue comments (`.github/workflows/plan.yml:1658-1660`). Extra tracked previous-plan paths therefore enter `ordered` ahead of the deferred plan paths and the current-request paths.
  WHY: When the previous plan has enough tracked paths, they fill the ten-path cap and exclude the current request's paths, so the evidence pack has no PR or history context for those paths.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:collect_paths lines 262-295 (specifically line 267 `plan_limit = MAX_PATHS // 2 if text else MAX_PATHS`, line 277 `raw_candidates = list(_tfc.extract_paths_from_plan(_likely_section(text)))`, and line 285 `path not in seen`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On a re-plan, the split reserves at most 5 slots for previous-plan paths, but the text branch extracts paths again from the same previous-plan content. `.github/workflows/plan.yml:1658-1659` appends `ALL COMMENTS` (newest plan comment last), and `_likely_section(text)` (evidence_pack.py lines ~245-252) returns text from the LAST heading onward. Deferred paths are not in `seen`, so they are re-added at line 291-293, and the current issue's paths are never extracted.
  WHY: When the previous plan names more than 5 tracked files, `collect_paths` returns 10 previous-plan paths and zero current-issue paths, which is the failure the last-run change was meant to fix. `test_replan_keeps_slots_for_issue_paths_when_previous_plan_is_long` does not cover this ordering.
- HARDENING: scripts/evidence_pack.py, Builder.history finally block (line ~427, `_git(root, ["update-ref", "-d", HISTORY_REF])`)
  PROBLEM: The result of the private-ref delete is discarded. A leftover `refs/persist/history.lock` leaves the ref undeleted while PERSIST still reports ok/partial with no cleanup reason.
  WHY: Suggested fix: when the result is None or `returncode != 0`, set `self.partial = True` and `self.reason = self.reason or "history_ref_cleanup_failed"`. About 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
